name: CaresortSolutions Tabs & Accordion for Elementor
author: caresortsolutions

sections.description:
CaresortSolutions Tabs & Accordion for Elementor adds one flexible widget to your Elementor editor that can function either as a tabbed content panel or as an accordion, with a single click to switch between the two layouts. Each mode keeps its own independent styling controls, so you can fine-tune tabs and accordion presentations separately without rebuilding your content.

Key features:

  • One widget, two layouts: Tabs or Accordion
  • Independent styling controls per layout mode
  • Lightweight front-end assets (dedicated CSS and JS)
  • Built specifically for the Elementor page builder

Requirements

  • Elementor plugin installed and activated
sections.installation:
1. Upload the caresortsolutions-tabs-accordion-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor and search for “CaresortSolutions Tabs & Accordion” in the widget panel.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. CaresortSolutions Tabs & Accordion is an add-on widget for Elementor and will not function without the Elementor plugin installed and active.

Can I use tabs and accordion styling independently?

Yes. Each layout mode (Tabs and Accordion) has its own dedicated styling controls, so switching modes does not affect the styles you’ve configured for the other.

short_description: A single advanced Elementor widget that works as Tabs or Accordion — switch layouts instantly with full independent styling for each mode.
